q: A consuming department needs an item held in a stores depot. Instead of sending a paper indent and visiting the depot, the department views the depot stock position and raises its demand online. This is done through:

options.B: GeM
options.C: UDM, the User Depot Module of iMMS

q: A railway has to dispose of a lot of scrap. Buyers are to bid upwards in an online sale. The correct route and system are:

options.B: Direct purchase on GeM

q: In a stores tender on IREPS, offers have been opened and some are found technically acceptable while others are rejected. A further online round is to be held to arrive at L-1. This round can be held:

options.A: Among all tenderers who submitted bids
options.B: Only among tenderers whose offers were found technically acceptable
options.C: Only among the rejected tenderers, to give them a second chance

q: An office needs a commonly used item that is available on the Government e-Marketplace. Under the General Financial Rules, the item is required to be procured:

options.B: Only through a local paper tender
options.D: Through UDM demand on a depot

q: A contractor wishes to bid in a railway works e-tender. There is no sealed-cover paper bid. To submit his bid, the contractor must:

options.A: Register as a seller on GeM and quote in the catalogue
options.B: Deposit earnest money in cash at the cash office only
options.C: Send the bid by registered post to the tender box
options.D: Register on the IREPS portal and submit the bid using a valid Digital Signature Certificate

q: Before a purchase order linked with the e-procurement system is issued, a pre-check of the purchase order is required. This pre-check is carried out:

options.A: Under the relevant module of the materials management system linked with IREPS
options.B: Manually in the cash office register

q: A depot's priced stores ledger position has to be checked by Accounts against the system figures, and the related suspense positions examined. The stores chain that produces these figures runs as:

options.B: GeM (buy) → e-Office (hold) → FOIS (pay)
options.C: IREPS (buy) → iMMS/UDM (hold and issue) → IPAS/accounts (pay and book)

q: Audit of a recent stores purchase finds no paper tender file but a complete system record of tender publication, bid submission, opening and tabulation. This audit trail is available because the procurement was processed through:

options.B: IREPS, where tender stages are system-driven and logged

q: A user department repeatedly draws an item from a depot and wants to confirm the balance available before raising a fresh demand, so that the demand is realistic. The stock visibility for this purpose is provided in:

options.B: ARPAN pension record

q:
Consider the following statements about IREPS and GeM:
1. IREPS is the Railways' own e-procurement system for works tenders and stores tenders.
2. Goods and services available on GeM are required to be procured through GeM under the General Financial Rules.
3. GeM is the Railways' works-tendering system.
Which of the statements given above are correct?

options.B: 2 and 3 only

q: The User Depot Module (UDM) is a module of:

options.B: iMMS

q: Sale of scrap by the Railways through online bidding, where buyers bid upwards, is conducted as:

options.B: Direct purchase on GeM

q: Receipts, issues, stock ledgers and balances of stores depots are maintained in:

options.B: e-Recon

q: The rule framework under which procurement through GeM is mandated for goods and services available on it is:

options.B: General Financial Rules (GFR)
options.C: Appendix III-A of the Accounts Code

q: A bidder's identity and authority to submit a bid on IREPS rest on registration on the portal together with:

options.B: A paper power of attorney filed in the depot

q: Which of the following statements about UDM is NOT correct?

options.A: It lets a user department view the stock position of items in depots
options.B: It lets a user department raise its demands online
options.C: It is the face of iMMS for the consuming department
options.D: It is the module through which works tenders are invited and opened

q: Which of the following statements about GeM is NOT correct?

options.A: It is the platform for sale of railway scrap by e-auction
options.B: Accounts check on a GeM purchase includes verifying rates and quantities against the GeM order
options.C: It is the Government of India's online marketplace for goods and common services
options.D: Government buyers, including the Railways, procure through it

q: Which of the following statements about auctions in railway e-procurement is NOT correct?

options.A: In an e-auction the Railways sell and the price moves up
options.B: In a reverse auction the Railways buy and technically acceptable suppliers bid the price down
options.C: A reverse auction is held among all tenderers, including those whose offers were rejected
options.D: Scrap sale is the typical case of an e-auction

q: Which of the following statements about iMMS is NOT correct?

options.A: Its user-side window for consuming departments is UDM
options.B: It works alongside IREPS for stores procurement and inventory
options.C: Depot stock ledgers and balances are maintained in it
options.D: It processes pension revision for railway pensioners

q:
Match the system with its primary role:
I. IREPS   II. GeM   III. iMMS   IV. UDM
a. User department views depot stock and raises demands online
b. Depot stock, receipts, issues and inventory management
c. Government marketplace for goods and common services
d. Railway e-tendering for works and stores, e-auction of scrap

options.B: I-c, II-d, III-b, IV-a
